title: Ashbury Rewards Elite Courtesy on Room Reservations No-Show Charges
content:
On a no-show charge on a Room Reservations reservation, Ashbury Rewards elite members receive a tier courtesy.

| Tier of the attached Ashbury Rewards membership | Elite night credits this year needed | Tier courtesy taken off the charge |
|---|---|---|
| Titanium Elite or Ambassador Elite | at least 50 | 30% |
| Platinum Elite or Gold Elite | at least 25 | 20% |
| Silver Elite | at least 10 | 10% |
| Any tier below its figure, Member, or no membership attached | — | none |

**Benefit wording.** A guest whose attached Ashbury Rewards membership holds the Titanium Elite or Ambassador Elite tier with at least 50 elite night credits this year has the top no-show courtesy of 30% taken off the charge; one whose membership holds the Platinum Elite or Gold Elite tier with at least 25 elite night credits has the middle no-show courtesy of 20% taken off; one whose membership holds the Silver Elite tier with at least 10 elite night credits has the silver no-show courtesy of 10% taken off; any other guest has no tier courtesy (0%).

**Reading the table.** Each tier group is held to its own figure: a Titanium Elite member with 40 elite night credits, or a Gold Elite member with 20, holds no tier of a lower group and so receives no courtesy. The records read are the tier and the current calendar year's elite night credits of the membership attached to the reservation.

**Where it acts.** The courtesy takes its share off the no-show charge as it stands at that point, before the charge is rounded.

**Illustration (hypothetical charge of 247.50 before the courtesy).** Ambassador Elite with 61 credits: 173.25. Platinum Elite with 25 credits: 198.00. Silver Elite with 10 credits: 222.75. Silver Elite with 9 credits: 247.50.
